notes.title: Halloween Spooktacular
notes.content:
From the beginning of October for 5 weeks you will have the option of playing a Halloween-themed version of Grid Words, featuring a spooky soundtrack, a creepy backdrop and Halloween-themed words to find.

Don't forget to collect all the special Halloween achievements.

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Sci-fi Spectacular
notes.content:
To celebrate Star Wars day on May 4th you will have the option of playing a new sci-fi version of Grid Words throughout the whole of May.  The new theme features two new soundtracks, a new backdrop, sci-fi themed words to find and special achievements.

May the 4th be with you.

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Valentine Vibes
notes.content:
From Wednesday 1st February for 4 weeks you will have the option of playing a new Valentine version of Grid Words, featuring a romantic soundtrack, a new backdrop and special words to find.  Plus, don't forget to collect all the Valentine achievements.

We will also have a weeklong deal from Monday 13th February, so why not buy a copy of Grid Words for the gamer in your life?

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Festive Fun
notes.content:
From Monday 19th December for 3 weeks you will have the option of playing a new festive version of Grid Words, featuring a seasonal soundtrack, a new backdrop and festive words to find.

Don't forget to collect all the special festive achievements.

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː
